epics.title: Accountable engineering loop
epics.objective: Enforce decision 0032 end to end: JIT frontier contracts gated at stage start, evidence-backed grills, bounded reviewable diffs.

tasks.title: Task grills carry proof and rounds
tasks.objective: Task-gate grills require inspected_refs (existing paths), current_flow, a total criteria_map, a keep/split/block decision, declare-or-empty new_abstractions, and at least one recorded human round; pass with split/block refused; block requires an escalation packet. Existing task-grill fixtures migrate.
acceptance_criteria: a task grill missing any proof field, with an unmapped criterion, zero rounds, pass+split/block, or block without an escalation packet is refused
a fully-proved grill records; existing suite green after fixture migration

tasks.title: Grounding digest derived internally
tasks.objective: record_grill_from_json.py derives the task-grill digest from the full contract, the approved-plan digest excluding appended assumptions, and a product-tree hash excluding .factory/ and plans/; --task-digest is removed; require_task_grill and task_frontier_state re-derive.
acceptance_criteria: contract, plan-body, and product-tree changes each stale a grill; .factory/ and plans/ commits and forge plan assume do not
caller-supplied --task-digest is gone; gates and recorder agree on the derivation

tasks.title: Frozen skeleton, immutable completed contracts, plan_contracts wiring
tasks.objective: Initial decomposition recording refuses execution detail on every task and reviewer_focus/plan_contracts on non-frontier tasks; re-records freeze pending id/order/dependencies and refuse changes to a done task's full contract; the task grill refuses when criteria_map does not cover acceptance criteria or mismatches declared plan_contracts.
acceptance_criteria: first recording is fully skeletal; pending graph edits refused; done contracts immutable under a full-contract digest
criteria_map must cover acceptance criteria and match plan_contracts or the grill is refused

tasks.title: Review budget at stage done and in the brief
tasks.objective: Tasks may declare review_budget (default 8 files/400 lines excluding .factory/ and plans/; lower free, higher needs a written reason); stage done refuses an over-budget diff with split guidance; the composed brief states the budget and the conduct s8 narration line.
acceptance_criteria: default, lowered, justified-higher, and exceeded budgets behave as specified at stage done
the brief carries the budget and narration lines

tasks.title: Board renders task rows
tasks.objective: The board's in-flight story drawer shows one row per task (state skeleton|ready|grilled|active|done, grill freshness, budget usage) from the same shared derivation forge next uses.
acceptance_criteria: board task rows match task_frontier_state for every state
